listing.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King — Original Xbox (Athelas ports/rotk-xbox)
listing.summary: Play the original Xbox version of The Return of the King through Athelas.
listing.original_game_title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King

steps.title: Use Athelas with your own original Xbox game
steps.instruction: Extract the complete official Athelas package into its own folder and deliberately open Athelas.exe. Select the original Xbox version of The Return of the King and provide your own USA disc ISO or matching extracted game files as the launcher requests. No game files or separate Xbox BIOS are supplied by Portcove. This is the distinct Athelas component ROTK-Xbox/ROTKXbox.exe; the PC ROTK Fix enhancement and the other two Xbox games keep separate identities and original inputs. Source builds and game-code translation are developer routes, not additional player setup questions.

steps.title: Keep upstream setup and updates together
steps.instruction: Use Athelas for game selection, settings and Play. You can register Athelas.exe with its extracted folder as the working directory; this deliberately opens the launcher, where you choose this game. The supplied component is ROTK-Xbox/ROTKXbox.exe, but using the launcher preserves its supported setup/settings workflow. Athelas owns runtime updates, including its Update now replacement and restart. Existing external files stay external: Portcove does not promise managed Update, Backup or Rollback.

steps.title: Preserve this component's data
steps.instruction: Back up the actual launcher folder and this game's ROTK-Xbox/saves directory before changing versions. This game has its own settings; ROTK-Xbox/settings.toml is separate from another Xbox game and from the PC game's ROTKFix.ini. Keep your original disc/files and any custom mods, logs, crash dumps or moved data separately. Upstream describes Windows 10/11 x64 and Direct3D 12 for the Xbox components; Proton/CrossOver observations are not native Linux/macOS qualification. Exact accepted original executable revision/hash, native execution, gameplay and real-save restoration remain unqualified here. Existing historical lineage questions and canonical acceptance remain with this component's owner.
